ABOUT COSMIC BULL

Cosmic Bull is live!

Cosmic Bull is a Gno Application Factory building and deploying open on-chain software.

Discover → Compose → Build → Verify → Deploy

We're building the Cosmic Bull community and inviting early supporters, developers, creators, researchers, and Gno ecosystem participants to join us.

YOUR TASK

Become an early Cosmic Bull Founding Community Member.

Complete the following:

1. 🌐 Visit Cosmic Bull
https://cosmicbull.net

2. 𝕏 Follow Cosmic Bull on X
https://x.com/cosmicbulll?s=11

3. 💬 Join the Cosmic Bull Discord
https://discord.gg/2P9WSw8Np

4. 📱 Join the Cosmic Bull Telegram
https://t.me/+YHGMoCNdMrlhMDBh

5. 💻  GitHub
https://github.com/SillyZir

SUBMISSION

After completing the onboarding, submit:

Gno wallet address:
g1...

@username

username

@username

VERIFICATION QUESTION

What is Cosmic Bull's application factory workflow?

Answer:

Discover → Compose → Build → Verify → Deploy

VERIFICATION

Submissions will be reviewed before rewards are released.

Cosmic Bull will verify:

✓ Gno wallet address
✓ X account
✓ Discord membership
✓ Telegram membership
✓ Completion of the Cosmic Bull onboarding
✓ Correct answer to the verification question

Approved contributors receive 10 GNOT.

Duplicate, fraudulent, automated, or otherwise invalid submissions will not qualify.

One reward per individual.

BOUNTY ALLOCATION

2,500 GNOT total

10 GNOT × 250 approved contributors

The bounty closes when all 250 rewards have been awarded or the 2,500 GNOT allocation has been exhausted.

BECOME AN EARLY COSMIC BULL COMMUNITY MEMBER  ⚛️ 🐂

This is the beginning of the Cosmic Bull community.

Future Cosmic Bull bounties will reward contributors for building applications, creating reusable Gno packages, research, security reviews, tutorials, content, and other ecosystem contributions.

files.name: durations.gno
files.body:
package memba_gov

import "time"

// The policy's durations, in their own file so a node fixture, which cannot
// wait days, can replace this file alone and run the real rules faster.
const (
	VotingPeriod    = 7 * 24 * time.Hour
	ExecutionWindow = 7 * 24 * time.Hour
	WeightedDelay   = 24 * time.Hour // critical, weight route
	HeadcountDelay  = 72 * time.Hour // critical, headcount route
	RosterDelay     = 7 * 24 * time.Hour
	InactiveDelay   = 14 * 24 * time.Hour
	InactiveAfter   = 180 * 24 * time.Hour
	SeedInviteTTL   = 90 * 24 * time.Hour
	VotedInviteTTL  = 30 * 24 * time.Hour
)
